Overview

Cuttack is a city in Odisha with a population of 650,000. The former capital of Odisha, known for its silver filigree work, historic Barabati Fort, and as a commercial center. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. The population skews young, with a median age of 28.0.
